title: Court-interpreting requests at a tribunal, by language
bodyMd: The table shows, for the five languages in which a provincial tribunal most often needed an interpreter, the number of interpreting requests in 2023 and in 2024, and the average interpreting time per request in 2024. Each request covered a single hearing.

data.caption: Interpreting requests in 2023 and 2024 and average interpreting time per request in 2024, for Albanian, Arabic, Chinese, Romanian and Ukrainian, at a provincial tribunal.

accessibilityText: A table with five data rows and four columns: Language; Requests, 2023; Requests, 2024; and Average interpreting time per request in 2024, in minutes. Albanian: 240 requests in 2023, 300 in 2024, average 40 minutes. Arabic: 420 requests in 2023, 360 in 2024, average 50 minutes. Chinese: 150 requests in 2023, 210 in 2024, average 60 minutes. Romanian: 320 requests in 2023, 400 in 2024, average 40 minutes. Ukrainian: 50 requests in 2023, 90 in 2024, average 30 minutes. Each request covered a single hearing.

provenance.notes: Invented data for a fictional provincial tribunal. The figures were chosen so that every percentage change and every total interpreting time can be computed mentally, and so that the language with the most requests, the language with the longest average and the language with the greatest total time are three different languages.
